sources.notes: Retrieved as GET /repos/tj-actions/changed-files/security-advisories/GHSA-mw4p-6x4p-x5m5. Material statements: the full malicious commit, the three example tags, the March 14 to March 15, 2025 period without clock time or timezone, patched version 46.0.0, and the memory-reading behavior that wrote encoded output into logs. The advisory also shows the payload command and names gist.githubusercontent.com; neither is encoded as an indicator.
